name: Retro Terminal
tagline: typewriter-video's retro terminal: phosphor green on black, amber for the key line, scanlines, text typed with a cursor.

motion.direction: typewriter-video `retro-terminal`. A phosphor terminal: every poster line is TYPED character by character (2–3 frames each) with a block cursor, in JetBrains Mono, green `ter`; the key line of a chapter in amber `gold`; a `chapterCard` as a new file tab (`$ chapter 02`), lists as `chips` typed in a burst, numbers as mono `counter`s, a `stamp` [OK] / [FAIL] / [DONE]. Text appears 0.3–0.5 s before the phrase ends and never lags the speaker; one board note every 4–6 s, max 6 s blank. Camera still, hard cuts, keyboard clicks per character. Lowercase, terse — the board is a simplified version of the speech.
